cohort: Two twin pregnant women who developed preterm prelabor rupture of membranes (PPROM) in the early second trimester (12 and 16 weeks of gestation).
finding: Expectant management for early second-trimester PPROM in twin pregnancies can result in successful deliveries at near-term gestational ages and normal infant development.
gest_age: PPROM occurred at 12 and 16 weeks; deliveries at 34+4 to 34+6 weeks.
